scope: Measured DFM screening of the canonical CameraBoardEnvelope hole-counterpart STEP against an Original Prusa MK4S build volume. Not a purchase, not a selected printer, not flight.
evidenceBoundary: Build volume 250 x 210 x 220 mm from https://www.prusa3d.com/product/original-prusa-mk4s-3d-printer/ inspected 2026-09-11. Overhang 75 deg from the same MK4S product claim (print steep overhangs without supports). First-layer 0.20 mm from PrusaSlicer official layers article used as Z-min bed-contact tolerance, not a manufacturer Z-min spec. Min thickness 0.80 mm = two 0.40 mm default-nozzle perimeters (MK4S default nozzle 0.4 mm on the same product page). Mesh 1.0 mm is a DFM sampling size, not a print spec. STEP sha256 2572f73d… is the sealed CameraBoardEnvelope write-geometry@1 file. Isolated CAD is not the target. Does not select a printer SKU.
limitations: Printer is a sourced screening envelope, not a selected ID01 machine.
Z-min tolerance is PrusaSlicer first-layer 0.20 mm, not a Prusa Z-min specification.
Mesh 1 mm is DFM sampling only.
Does not authorize manufacture, purchase, or flight.

provenance.note: Screening DFM case authored 2026-09-11 from official MK4S volume and CameraBoardEnvelope canonical STEP. HOLD propulsion unrelated.
